quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report, consolidated, reviewed by Ichon Accounting): revenue KRW 215,130M, which the company says is about 24% above H1 2025 (KRW 169,780,007,084), and operating profit KRW 35,651M, about 32% higher (H1 2025: KRW 28,005,339,411). Q2 alone revenue was KRW 99,243,908,463 (Q2 2025: KRW 97,438,094,351) while Q2 operating profit fell to KRW 15,459,264,221 from KRW 18,109,955,560 as warranty (defect-repair) expense for the half rose to KRW 16,126,864 thousand from KRW 8,294,212 thousand. Mix: scrubbers KRW 136,326,659 thousand (63.4%), chillers KRW 37,739,090 thousand (17.5%), services 16.8% and merchandise 2.3%; exports were 61.6% of revenue. The average scrubber price rose to KRW 144,315 thousand per unit from KRW 135,999 thousand in FY2025. R&D spend was KRW 9,957M, 4.8% of parent revenue and up 39.3% year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 rev KRW 215,130M (~+24%); H1 OP KRW 35,651M (~+32%); Q2 rev KRW 99,243,908,463 (vs KRW 97,438,094,351); Q2 OP KRW 15,459,264,221 (vs KRW 18,109,955,560); scrubbers 63.4% / chillers 17.5% / services 16.8%; exports 61.6%; scrubber ASP KRW 144,315 thousand; warranty expense KRW 16,126,864 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog and customer concentration (DART half-year report): parent-only equipment orders stood at KRW 2,708 hundred million including the carried-over backlog, of which KRW 1,740 hundred million had been delivered, leaving a backlog of KRW 968 hundred million (scrubbers KRW 766 hundred million, chillers KRW 202 hundred million); the company withholds customer names, delivery dates and quantities because they would expose customers' investment plans. Two unnamed customers each exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026: customer A KRW 96,427,356 thousand (44.82%) and customer B KRW 75,222,636 thousand (34.97%); a year earlier customer A was 42.16% and customer C 18.57%.
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog KRW 968 hundred million (scrubbers 766, chillers 202); customer A 44.82% (KRW 96,427,356 thousand), customer B 34.97% (KRW 75,222,636 thousand); H1 2025: A 42.16%, C 18.57%

quarterly_data.signal: Production and investment (DART half-year report): the Dongtan plant built 1,129 scrubbers and 713 chillers in H1 2026, 1,842 units in total, which the company says is about 18% more than a year earlier (FY2025 full year: 2,878 units); it does not state a capacity or utilisation figure because output depends on assembly space and staffing rather than fixed equipment. H1 purchases of property, plant and equipment were KRW 9,969,878,328 and construction in progress rose to KRW 14,067,810 thousand from KRW 8,511,243 thousand; finished-goods inventory rose to KRW 30,391,826 thousand from KRW 18,015,704 thousand. The company says Korean chipmakers are pulling their capex schedules ahead of plan, while China's localisation drive may trim Korean suppliers' share of Chinese customers versus 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 production 1,129 scrubbers + 713 chillers = 1,842 units (~+18%); H1 capex KRW 9,969,878,328; CIP KRW 14,067,810 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Next-generation products (DART half-year report): new domestic scrubber installations are mostly plasma-wet types, and the company, like other suppliers, is running customer demos of its own catalyst-type scrubber, which it expects to become a core future tool because it sharply cuts power use. It says it is delivering and demonstrating CO2-refrigerant chillers to global customers, and is developing ultra-low-temperature (-100 degree class natural refrigerant), -40 and -20 degree class and high-temperature chillers for advanced etch and CVD. In immersion cooling for AI data centres it completed single-phase and two-phase models in 2023 (including a 24U data-centre unit and a 6U edge unit for AI servers) and is in PoC with customers; management expects that market to open from as early as end-2027 when new AI data-centre builds ramp.
quarterly_data.figure: Immersion cooling: single- and two-phase models developed 2023, in customer PoC; market expected to open from end-2027
